nbis.headline: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan (Singapore, Mon): capital, not chips, may be the biggest AI build-out constraint; many AI investors 'like a casino'; demand still exceeds supply ~2 yrs.
nbis.why: Hits the exact NBIS risk: debt-funded neocloud capex at 5%+ long yields. Demand line is supportive; funding-cost line is the overhang.

nbis.headline: Offset: Alphabet's Porat says ~$200B 2026 AI capex, 'increase significantly' in 2027, still capacity constrained. Rosenblatt Buy PT $304 carries; MarketBeat consensus PT ~$245.69.
